description: ASTROLUNOX is a team of passionate and creative innovators driven by curiosity, science, and technology. We aim to explore the mysteries of space, transform innovative ideas into meaningful solutions, and tackle real-world challenges using NASA data. Through teamwork, collaboration, and creativity, we strive to push boundaries, discover new possibilities, and make a positive impact on Earth and beyond. Together, we explore, innovate, and reach for the stars!
summary:
The comic tells the story of the Golden Record, a golden disc carried by NASA's Voyager 1 spacecraft, launched in 1977. The record was created to share information about Earth and humanity with possible life beyond our planet.

It contains music, human greetings, sounds of nature, and pictures that represent human life, culture, and civilization. As Voyager 1 travels farther into space, it continues to carry this special message from Earth.

The comic also highlights how the Golden Record remains an important part of human history. It reminds us of our identity, achievements, and the importance of preserving our stories for future generations.

Overall, the comic teaches us that even though objects may travel far away, the memories, stories, and messages they carry can last forever.
